picks.what: The city and the South Bay from Fort Nicholas after the siege, tinted lithograph (Library of Congress)
picks.why: general view of the town across the South Bay, debris of the siege in front; mount, caption and color bar trimmed off

picks.what: The Hero City Obelisk on Cape Khrustalny across the bay, photograph
picks.why: recognizable landmark on the waterfront; only usable modern view

gaps: P0–P3: no candidates; P5: only a 1916 ship scene with the Romanov family (#7) and a single building (#8)
notes: All P4 candidates are Crimean War prints, so #2 is marked as an event view. #1 (the docks with the ruined Fort St. Paul, 1856) is the same series but shows the docks rather than the town; #3–#6 are distant siege-line and battle scenes. #9 is a dull, overcast snapshot; drop it if a blank P6 plate is preferred. #10 and #12 are dominated by Russian flags; #11 is a single waterfront building.
